title: الْهُدْهُدُ – الْوَطْواطُ (هـ/و)
title_note: اعرض الصورة واسأل: ماذا ترون؟ بماذا تذكّركم؟
objective: I can tell ه from و, compare the hoopoe and the bat, and hear tanween.
criteria: I can hear ه and و in the two songs.
I can read the text and say how the hoopoe and the bat are different.
I can hear tanween at the end of words.
I can say opposites like أعلى × أسفل.

hook.head: يَطيرانِ 🦇
